observation.command: echo "=== kc login page via caddy ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:4000/kc/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=account&redirect_uri=http://localhost:4000/&response_type=code&scope=openid" 2>&1; echo "=== kc-admin via caddy ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:4000/kc-admin/" 2>&1; echo "=== keycloak realm info ==="; curl -sS "http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/.well-known/openid-configuration" 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; echo "=== VectorEmbedding count ==="; docker exec startuphafen-database psql -U app -d app -c "SELECT count(*) FROM \"VectorEmbedding\";" 2>&1; echo "=== extension ==="; docker exec startuphafen-database psql -U app -d app -c "SELECT extname FROM pg_extension;" 2>&1
